subject: Reconcile vendor intake: PO number issuance, spend cap discrepancy, and SKU linecodes
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <s.klein@auroracorp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@auroracorp.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor intake - missing SKU codes and spend cap mismatch (Aurora onboarding)

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking this on. We're trying to finish the vendor intake for Aurora Corp and hit two blockers that are stopping procurement from issuing a formal PO:

1) The onboarding form we submitted (attached) lacked the SKU/line-item codes your ledger expects — the CSV we exported from our ERP uses a different item code set.
2) The spend cap on your provisional PO estimate (your portal showed $75,000) is lower than the internal forecast here (we need ~$120,000 for Q1 usage).

Can you confirm whether you need us to resubmit the form using your SKU taxonomy or if you can map the codes on your side? Also, is there a path to set the provisional spend cap higher while we finalize contract approvals?

Attachments: Aurora_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Sarah Klein
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Corp
[s.klein@auroracorp.com]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <s.klein@auroracorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - missing SKU codes and spend cap mismatch (Aurora onboarding)

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear note and the attachment. Quick answers up front: we can provisionally reserve a PO number and increase the spend cap pending receipt of your line-item mapping, but we need either (A) a vendor form that includes Aurora's tax ID + billing contact (so finance has a tax record) and a CSV with SKU->description->unit price, or (B) a short mapping file we can use to translate your ERP codes to our SKU catalog.

What I can do immediately: reserve a provisional PO number (we'll mark it provisional until legal completes the T&Cs). I can also raise the temporary spend cap to $120k for the onboarding window if Finance signs off. I'm looping in Monica from Procurement Ops (cc) to confirm process for provisional cap bump and Ben from Billing in case we need a billing code exception.

Can you confirm the tax ID and upload the CSV mapping? If you prefer, send the mapping inline and I'll run a quick reconcile.

— Logan
Logan Wright | Procurement Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: PO_request_template.csv]

Hi Logan / Monica,

Attached is a corrected onboarding bundle and an exported CSV of our current line items. I added a small mapping column named RDW_SKU_SUGGEST that is our best guess for the equivalent Redwood SKU. We weren't sure about one item (SYS-INTEGRATE-01) — that one is a service fee that might map to a generic consulting SKU on your side.

Tax ID: 82-1234567
Billing contact: accounts.payable@auroracorp.com

Attachments: Aurora_PO_lines_7534.csv

On the spend cap, we can provisionally approve $120k but I'd like the note in the PO that any usage beyond that will require approval from our finance lead (I can provide their contact if required).

Thanks,
Sarah

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <s.klein@auroracorp.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor intake - missing SKU codes and spend cap mismatch (Aurora onboarding)

Sarah —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the mapping column — that makes reconciliation far easier. Summary of actions and decisions from our side:

- Provisional PO number assigned: PO-7534-PROV (status: provisional until legal completes signatures).
- Temporary spend cap: set to $120,000 for the onboarding period (30 days) per your request. We will include the clause: "Usage beyond $120,000 requires Aurora finance approval (contact required)." Please send the finance lead contact if you want a named approver in the note.
- Line-item corrections: We ran your CSV against our SKU catalog; three rows required normalization (SYS-INTEGRATE-01 -> RDW-SERVICE-03, ITEM-998 -> RDW-HW-21, ITEM-412 -> RDW-CONFIG-02). I've attached a reconciled CSV stub for your review.
- Next steps: 
  * Sarah: confirm Aurora finance approver name/email for PO note.
  * Logan: flag PO-7534-PROV for Legal to prioritize export of the provisional T&Cs.
  * Ben: after legal signs off, please convert PO-7534-PROV to a final PO and send invoice routing instructions to accounts.payable@auroracorp.com.

Attachments: [Attachment stub: Aurora_PO_lines_7534_reconciled.csv]

If everyone is aligned I'll mark the ticket resolved in JIRA (JIRA-PO-7534) and move to finalization queue.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
